# pattern: # Spanish phrasebook (C13; teacher-editable; es-MX register). Same columns and syntax as phrasebook_en_la.tsv:
# lower-case words matched against each token's lower form or lemma (write the inflected form when the Latin is
# person-specific: "tengo hambre", not "tener hambre"), slots {NP} {NAME} {VP} {ADJ} {NUM} {WH}, optional tokens in
# (...), alternatives a|b (one word each); contractions_es.tsv applies to patterns ("del" = "de el"). Inverted marks
# ¿ ¡ are punctuation and never part of a pattern. Enclitic pronouns are written apart and without the written stress
# ("pasa me {NP}" for "Pásame ..."), as the tokenizer splits them; a one-word row ("siéntate", "ándale") is never split. Our own rows, mirroring the English phrasebook.
